summary: Grab Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 5, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 financial results via an earnings release (Exhibit 99.1). The filing discloses Q1 2026 revenue of $955 million (up 24% YoY), On-Demand GMV of $6.1 billion (up 24% YoY), profit of $120 million, and Adjusted EBITDA of $154 million (up 46% YoY). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is announced. The filing is a routine periodic earnings announcement and does not constitute a special situation.
